# jtt config default

Set the project reports use when `-p` is left out.

![jtt config default OPS, then jtt projects --configured](gifs/config-default.gif)

```console
$ jtt config default OPS
$ jtt projects --configured
```

The project must be set up first, with [`jtt init`](init.md) or
[`jtt config set`](config-set.md). `jtt init` makes the first project it sets up the default,
and `-p KEY` still picks another project for one command.

## Options

<!-- options -->

```text
jtt config default PROJECT [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PROJECT` | required | Project key. |
| `-h`, `--help` |  | Show the command's help and exit. |
